question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the highlighted word.

This __maxim__ has been used by many in the past.
solution:
The correct answer is "**proverb**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Maxim" means a few words that express a rule for good or sensible behaviour. **(कहावत)

 
 
• Example: One maxim that should be etched into the walls of all scientific institutions is to visualize your data
 
 
 
• **A proverb is a short, well-known saying that expresses a common truth or piece of advice**.(कहावत)
 
 
• Example: "Actions speak louder than words" is a proverb that means it's better to do something than just talk about it.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the word "proverb" is the synonym of the word "maxim."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Adverb: a word that modifies or describes a verb, adjective, or other adverb.
 
 
• Example: "quickly" is an adverb in the sentence "She ran quickly."
 
 
 
• Maximum: the greatest amount or highest level of something.
 
 
• Example: "The maximum speed limit on this road is 60 miles per hour."
 
 
 
• Phoneme: the smallest unit of sound in a language that can change the meaning of a word.
 
 
• Example: The words "cat" and "bat" differ by one phoneme (/k/ versus /b/).
